name: 1 Bedroom Apartment - City View
address: Malecón 1,  Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco, Mexico
description:
The apartment features a 1bedroom with 1 queen size bed, a living room with a sofa bed, a dining room, a fully equipped kitchen, a marble bathroom with a shower only, and a balcony overlooking Amapas Street to complete the experience for the ideal space to for up to 4 people.

One Beach Street is a uniquely charming boutique hotel in the heart of the Romantic Zone also known as Old Vallarta. The hotel has just 6 stories divided into 60 comfortable suites. It overlooks the iconic Los Muertos Beach where many of the town’s early (and sometimes famous) visitors enjoyed the tranquil beach life in an authentic Mexican fishing village.  One Beach Street still continues as a venue for reviving some of the quiet but vibrant glory of Puerto Vallarta’s history and its continuing presence as one of the most beautiful beach towns in the hemisphere.

One Beach Street hotel is your point of reference for Puerto Vallarta. It was one of the first hotels built in the area.  Today, it welcomes back generations of  Vallartans ”who return each year to enjoy the relaxed interiors and rustic colonial exteriors so admired by the town’s adopted visitors. One Beach Street maintains its quaint Mexican style and is well known for having the best location for its spacious 1 and 2-bedroom suites with kitchens and balconies, ideal for those long Puerto Vallarta Vacation “getaways”. 

On the second level, this Puerto Vallarta hotel features an attractive outdoor pool with lounge chairs and umbrellas surrounding the waist-high ceramic pool for a cooling afternoon dip, perhaps before a more adventurous leap into the welcoming Los Muertos waves.

Guests enjoy the property in part because One Beach Street is within walking distance of an incredible variety of restaurants, bars, and shopping. Los Muertos Beach is known for beach clubs, some with pools, DJs, and others with small music groups playing old songs for young (and old) travelers.  The atmosphere is lively and you are guaranteed to have a memorable experience!   The Romantic Zone in Puerto Vallarta or Old Town Vallarta is a famous “people watching” location day or night. And in addition to bars and restaurants,  you can also look forward to the galleries that have become a trendy stop while visiting Puerto Vallarta and your new One Beach Street South address in Mexico.

We know you will have the “best of the essence” of Old Vallarta if you choose One Beach Street.
Guests enjoy the surrounding One Beach Street neighborhoods.  Exploring the area is fun and easy.  
We wish you a great stay and we know you will have a wonderful, memorable time at One Beach Street Zona Romantica Puerto Vallarta, your new address in Puerto Vallarta.

address: 5 Portofino Drive,  Pensacola Beach, Florida, United States
description:
Resort fees are included with your reservation!

Experience the ultimate Gulf Coast escape in this stunning 2-bedroom residence at Portofino Island Resort, where elevated coastal living meets world-class resort amenities. Perfectly positioned beside the untouched beauty of the Gulf Islands National Seashore, this upscale retreat delivers a rare blend of privacy, luxury, and adventure.

From the moment you arrive, sweeping views of the emerald Gulf waters set the tone for an unforgettable stay. Step onto your private balcony to take in vibrant sunsets that stretch across the horizon, or unwind indoors where floor-to-ceiling windows fill the space with natural light and coastal serenity. The open-concept living area is designed for both comfort and style, featuring elegant seating and a flat-screen TV—ideal for relaxing after a day on the beach or exploring the resort. A fully equipped kitchen allows for effortless home-style dining, complemented by a dedicated dining area perfect for gathering and enjoying meals together. A private washer and dryer add convenience for extended stays. Both bedrooms offer a peaceful retreat with spacious layouts and thoughtfully curated design for restorative sleep. The spa-inspired bathrooms elevate the experience further, featuring modern finishes, a deep soaking tub, and a walk-in shower for a true resort-level escape. As a guest of Portofino Island Resort, you’ll enjoy access to an exceptional collection of amenities. Spend your days relaxing across seven outdoor pools or the indoor heated pool, soaking in whirlpool spas, or staying active on five Rubico tennis courts. The state-of-the-art fitness center overlooks the water, creating a one-of-a-kind workout setting. For those seeking adventure, the resort offers watersport rentals and a vibrant inflatable water park. When it’s time to unwind, indulge in rejuvenating treatments at Spa Portofino or simply enjoy the serene coastal atmosphere. End each day with a memorable dining experience at one of the on-site restaurants, a coffee or smoothie by the pool, or a visit to the Market for specialty items and souvenirs. This is more than a stay—it’s a true Gulf-front resort experience defined by comfort, convenience, and unforgettable views.

name: Smoky Mountain Views 1306
address: 1260 Ski View Dr,  Gatlinburg, Tennessee, United States
description:
This stunning, modern, mountain-top condo offers the most incredible views of Gatlinburg. Enjoy your own private balcony where you’ll have breathtaking views at 3,000 feet overlooking the beautiful Smoky Mountains. Watch the skiers at Ober Gatlinburg during the day and the lights of downtown Gatlinburg at night.

The Gatlinburg Summit complex is a gorgeous 4-mile drive from downtown and is the most picturesque setting in Gatlinburg. Enjoy the beautiful majesty and solitude of the Great Smoky Mountains while being close to a variety of activities for the whole family.


This recently remodeled condo features a fully stocked kitchen that’s perfect for a home-cooked meal. The beautifully decorated space features a modern design with a gorgeous, stacked stone fireplace and a spiral staircase leading up to the second level loft with skylight. Curl up and read a book in the cozy window seat, or enjoy your favorite show on one of the 4 flat-screen smart TVs throughout the unit. Spend the day hiking through Smoky Mountain National Park, or skiing at the amazing ski resort that sits right on the edge of the property. Head to downtown Gatlinburg or Pigeon Forge where you’ll find endless restaurants, year-round ice skating, the Tennessee Aquarium, Ripley’s Believe It or Not, Dixie Stampede, Dollywood, and so much more. Don’t forget about the Space Needle observation tower and the Sky Lift.

Come, and enjoy the open year-round pool and hot tubs. Rain, sunshine, hot or cold, you are taken care of with pool and hot tub amenities with a temp-controlled room.

name: Romantic Hideaway
address: 267 Cattail Ln,  Waynesville, North Carolina, United States
description:
This beautiful 2-bedroom cabin in picturesque Waynesville, North Carolina is located in a tranquil area with gorgeous mountain views. Come stay at this charming cabin and enjoy some of the best outdoor activities Waynesville offers, including horseback riding, golf, nature tours, museums, theaters and shopping. If you time it right, you’ll also enjoy a handful of events and festivals that are unique to this area. From waterfall hiking and cycling to fishing and more, Waynesville is a true outdoor enthusiast’s hot spot. Two of the most popular attractions in Waynesville are Cataloochee Valley and the Blue Ridge Parkway, which offer breathtaking views of the Great Smoky Mountains.

If you decide that this cabin is the place to be and you don’t need to venture out, you’ll find yourself on a beautiful patio and balcony, sitting back in a rocking chair, sipping some team or coffee and enjoing the fresh mountain air. 

This cabin features a fully-equipped kitchen. The cabin has its own private balcony and patio with outdoor furniture. There is plenty to do in this wonderful cabin, including 4 TVs. The game room has a lot to offer - a bumper pool, poker, arcade-style with classics, and a bar. There is a king bed in the master bedroom, and a queen bed in the second bedroom. Decorated with Mexican accents, the Deluxe Studio ocean-front rooms are perfect for couples or families. The rooms are quite spacious and the balconies are facing the ocean. You may spot dolphins early in the morning and even humpback whales late in the afternoons.  This is also a great way to admire the beautiful Puerto Vallarta sunsets.

Surrounded in tropical vegetation and peaceful landscaping within walking distance of the Princeville Shopping Center and also Anini Beach by way of a 12 minute hiking trail. The property is located on the Makai Golf Course and just around the corner from the both the Prince and the Princeville Golf Courses. Princeville has a walking path for all to enjoy, whether it be a morning stroll or a romantic sunset walk. For families there is park within walking distance.

Rock Ridge Resort Breckenridge is located high on a ridge with a forever westerly view, yet just three miles from Breckenridge’s Main Street. The free ski bus stops at the resort, so getting to town for shopping, dining, or skiing the slopes is stress-free.

Area Activities and Recreation – Summer: Golf, Tennis, Horseback Riding, Hiking, Mountain Biking, Fishing, Boating & Rafting or a day of Shopping. 
Winter: Skiing & Snowboarding, Cross Country Skiing, Snowmobiling, Sleigh Rides, ice-skating, or Tubing. Or partake in a relaxing evening of apre ski or dine at one of many fine restaurants in Breckenridge.

Escape to Dragon's Nest Cabin, a serene retreat nestled in the heart of Robbinsville, NC. This charming cabin offers breathtaking mountain views, providing an idyllic backdrop for your getaway. Located just moments from the legendary Tail of the Dragon, The Great Smoky Mountains, and Fontana Dam, it’s the perfect base for adventure enthusiasts and nature lovers alike.

Inside, you'll find a cozy haven with a king bed, twin bed, full bed, and a sofa bed, comfortably accommodating your family or group. The cabin’s inviting interior features a spacious living area, ideal for unwinding after a day of exploration. Step out onto the balcony to soak in the panoramic views or fire up the grill for a delightful outdoor meal.

With ample parking for vehicles and trailers, this cabin is especially suited for motorcyclists and those traveling with boats. Please note, the cabin is wheelchair inaccessible and adheres to a strict no-smoking policy, ensuring a fresh and welcoming environment for all guests.

Whether you're planning a family vacation, a special celebration, or a reunion, Dragon's Nest Cabin promises a memorable stay surrounded by the natural beauty of North Carolina's mountains.

Located off Interstate 70 in the Vail area, this aparthotel features year-round indoor and outdoor pools, and access to an area shuttle. Apartments offer a fully equipped kitchen.

A living area with a TV and DVD player is available in the condos at the Sandstone Creek Club Condominiums. A fireplace and either a balcony or patio are also included in the apartments.

A hot tub, sauna, steam room, and fitness centre are all offered at Sandstone. Guests can enjoy a basketball court, volleyball court, and barbecue facilities. Ski storage is available.

The Main Vail Ski Lifts are less than 15 minutes' drive from Sandstone. Vail Village is 4 km away and a free Sandstone Creek Club shuttle is available during ski season.

description:
When you stay at Seaside Beach & Racquet Club in Orange Beach, you’ll have wide beaches and warm emerald-green waters of the Gulf of Mexico serve as the main attraction. 

This resort destination comes with many more options for fun and relaxation and is an ideal destination for your family reunion, girls’ trip or any other special occasion. 

The outdoor pool overlooks the Gulf while a grassy lawn area outfitted with comfortable chairs is a perfect spot to relax or even enjoy a picnic lunch.

And don’t forget to check out the heated indoor pool. A steam room, sauna and fitness room are also part of the recreational mix at Seaside Beach & Racquet Club.

On-site tennis courts are available for all guests and are great for a nice early morning workout session. An elevated wooden deck with chairs and tables is available for those who wish to watch a friendly match.

description:
The Lake Placid Club Lodges is located on a portion of the property once known as the Lake Placid Club. A social and recreation club founded in 1895 in a hotel on Mirror Lake, the Club grew to 9,600 acres, with 356 buildings, its own theatre, library, boathouses, tennis courts, golf courses, farms, a staff of 1100, a fire department and even a school–today known as Northwood School.

Under Melvil Dewey’s leadership and according to his ideals, the Lake Placid Club was instrumental in Lake Placid’s development as an internationally-known resort. His son Godfrey was instrumental in bringing the Winter Olympics to Lake Placid in 1932. Without the club’s facilities and its national profile, Lake Placid would not have qualified to host the Games.

Enjoy the beautiful beaches of Del Mar from our Solana Beach resort, or experience your favorite attractions like SeaWorld® San Diego, LEGOLAND®, and the San Diego Zoo. Everything is minutes away, making our Solana Beach hotel the perfect choice for your upcoming family vacation, business travel, or a spontaneous getaway.

As your home away from home, our Solana Beach resort offers large suites with in-room kitchens and plenty of activities and amenities for you to enjoy during your stay. Let the kids splash around in our heated outdoor pool.
The clubhouse offers plenty of indoor fun—play a game on the pool table, ping-pong table, or watch the big game or a movie on the large-screen TV. When everyone gets hungry, cook up some hamburgers and hot dogs on our barbecue grills, or stop by one of our two on-site restaurants for a delicious, freshly prepared meal.

Vacation in absolute comfort with our spacious one- and two-bedroom Solana Beach hotel rooms and suites. 

Breathe in the fresh air from your private patio or balcony and settle into your home away from home with wonderful amenities and complimentary services.

Guests love the amenities we offer, including bathrooms and a fully stocked kitchenette with a refrigerator, range top, cooking equipment, and microwave. 

Experience the beauty of a beach resort with the luxury of upscale Solana Beach lodging, and you will never want to leave.

Experience the simple bliss of the family-friendly amenities at Winners Circle Resort. Located minutes from the shores of Del Mar’s top beaches, we provide comfortable, chic accommodations with a wide array of fabulous executive amenities. 

At our Solana Beach hotel with a pool, you’ll experience the highest level of indoor and outdoor amenities, as well as stellar guest services thanks to our 24-hour front desk.

Make yourself comfortable with all of our unique hotel features, including a shared heated outdoor pool, on-site salon, and two incredible restaurants. description:
Charming, spacious and nautical-themed condo located in Myrtle Beach with beautiful ocean views right from your own private balcony. 

This spacious 2 bedroom/2 bathroom oceanfront condo is located at Ocean Pier 3 in the highly desirable Windy Hill area of North Myrtle Beach. The condo with a charming nautical design has 2 spacious bedrooms with plenty of sleeping arrangements. It features 1 King bed in the 1st bedroom, 1 queen bed & 1 pull-out futon (for 1 person) in the 2nd bedroom.

The unit boasts a gorgeous flooring upgrade, stainless steel appliances, and excellent decor with an amazing view that will keep you in awe. Barefoot Landing is 1.3 miles away along with easy and direct access to highway 17. You won’t want to miss this opportunity to enjoy the beach from your own private condo with access to a private pool!

description:
Grand Park Royal Cozumel has award-winning architecture and interior design. It is recognized as one of the best hotels in Cozumel. Our 5-star resort is perfect for experiencing this fascinating island and enjoying excellent facilities, service, and activities.

The evocative Mayan-inspired atmosphere in our All-Inclusive hotel in Cozumel will inspire you while our exclusive beach, with crystal-clear waters, will refresh you. Enjoy our event halls, dip into our infinity pools with hot tubs, relax at our SPA, or taste our wide culinary offer. Your holiday or celebration at Grand Park Royal Cozumel will surpass your dreams! 

Internationally award-winning architecture makes Grand Park Royal Cozumel the perfect place to enjoy this spectacular island. From some of our rooms, you will be able to see the big cruise ships when they are docked at the port. The hotel’s facilities include jacuzzis at the beach, solarium, our famous Kids’ Club, a pool with a slide, Balinese beds and an outdoor theatre. Our specialty restaurants include Mexican, Caribbean and Italian cuisine, as well as our exclusive Café Solé. Our rooms include a minibar, free wifi, and 24 hour room service. You will be able to enjoy the hotel with your family and friends, choosing between our three amazing pools, walking along the beautiful gardens with exclusive access to the beach, where you can admire the ocean. Cozumel’s sunsets are endearing when surrounded by your loved ones in the ocean breeze.
